report: Wally fails to enforce mstateen0.ENVCFG (bit 62) for senvcfg execution controls in S-mode. When mstateen0[62] is 0, execution of cbo.zero in S-mode should raise an Illegal Instruction exception (mcause=2). Spike correctly traps, but Wally incorrectly executes the instruction without trapping. Both control and test were updated to set menvcfg.CBZE=1 before dropping to S-mode to avoid unrelated traps, and the tohost section was properly flagged as allocable.
evidence: In the control test (mstateen0[62]=1), both Spike and Wally successfully execute cbo.zero in S-mode. In the test case (mstateen0[62]=0), Spike traps with mcause=2 and goes to the success handler, while Wally does not trap and falls through to the failure handler.
